title: Pro Shop Store Credit: automatic-reload trigger basis
content:
## Basis
For a Pro Shop Store Credit tier that offers automatic reload, the trigger for considering an automatic reload remains in force as this policy originally set it: once the account's spendable balance drops below that tier's own trigger level, an automatic reload for that tier is considered.

The basis this policy formerly used to decide whether the reload actually posted in full — crediting the tier's own standing reload amount provided a payment method was on file where the tier required one, up to the tier's own cap on reload attempts within a calendar month — is no longer in force. The current basis for whether, and how much, an automatic reload actually credits, including how a member's standing elsewhere affects it, is governed elsewhere.

## Points of judgement
- The drops-below-trigger-level condition remains this policy's own live trigger; it is unaffected by the retirement described above.
- The payment-method and per-month attempt-count parameters remain valid tier parameters in their own right, even though the crediting basis that formerly read them here is no longer in force.

superseded_clauses: auto_reload_amount_usd is automatically added, provided a payment method is on file when auto_reload_payment_method_required applies, up to auto_reload_max_attempts_per_month attempts in a calendar month
